description: SERVER-ROUND16-PREREGISTRATION.md: S0, then 1bk (the budget round: BASE-TLS, TLS-RV and TLS-RVL at 20,000 and at 100,000 evaluations per run, no time limit; 7 datasets (Air, Con, Dow, EnC, EnH, Tow, Yac), fresh splits 81-90; 420 MOSES runs). One phase, no Boolean phase. No extension, no choice step, no adoption rule. The Dow manifest (8,192 MB) gets a W of its own. 1bk needs splits 81-90 of the 7 datasets (setup.sh builds them). No chain to or from another round.
